create_MujocoEnv_subclass: create a subclass of MujocoEnv that implements reset_model for a custom MuJoCo robot simulation
run_do_simulation: run a simulation step by calling do_simulation with control signals on a MujocoEnv instance
test_reset_method: test the reset method of a MujocoEnv subclass to verify it returns an observation after sim reset
render_MujocoEnv_offscreen: render an offscreen frame from a MujocoEnv using a specified camera name and resolution
set_state_MujocoEnv: set the simulation state by providing qpos and qvel arrays to set_state on a MujocoEnv
